args.reasoning: Evidence: 1) nginx logs show repeated errors: "connect() failed: Connection refused" with requests to "POST http://localhost:8080/wrk2-api/post/compose" (compose.lua:62) — proving nginx/Lua is attempting localhost:8080. 2) The Kubernetes Service for compose-post-service is ClusterIP 10.96.105.217 with port name/port/targetPort 9090 (Service spec). 3) Endpoints for compose-post-service point to pod 10.244.1.32 on port 9090. Conclusion: nginx is targeting the wrong host/port (localhost:8080) instead of the service DNS/IP and port 9090, causing connection refused.

final_report.root_cause: Two independent configuration errors caused the incident: (1) The Kubernetes Service for text-service was misconfigured to map port 9090 -> targetPort 9999 while the text-service container listens on 9090. This caused compose-post-service Thrift clients to be routed to port 9999 on the pod where no Thrift server was listening, producing immediate connection refused errors. (2) nginx-thrift (nginx + Lua) was misconfigured to call the compose endpoint at http://localhost:8080/wrk2-api/post/compose instead of the cluster service/port (compose-post-service:9090), causing nginx to get connection refused when proxying compose requests. Both misconfigurations together prevented compose flows from completing: nginx could not forward compose requests to the compose-post service, and compose-post could not reach text-service over Thrift.
affected_resources: Clients: user-facing compose requests (POST /wrk2-api/post/compose) and any downstream services relying on compose/text Thrift RPCs
final_report.evidence_summary: Priority #1 finding: compose-post-service logs show repeated Thrift failures 'TSocket::open() connect() <Host: text-service Port: 9090>: Connection refused' while the text-service pod is Running and its container listens on 9090. The text-service Kubernetes Service spec maps port 9090 to targetPort 9999, causing service-level routing to an unused port on the pod, producing the connection refusals. Priority #2 finding: nginx-thrift logs contain repeated 'connect() failed: Connection refused' for POST http://localhost:8080/wrk2-api/post/compose; the nginx ConfigMap shows it listens on 8080 and the Lua handler targets localhost:8080, while the compose-post-service is exposed via ClusterIP on port 9090 (endpoints at 10.244.1.32:9090). These two misconfigurations (Service targetPort mismatch and nginx targeting localhost:8080) were observed and correlated with the timestamps of the failures.
final_report.investigation_summary: Investigation prioritized the dependency chain (compose -> text). Priority #1: inspected text-service pod (kubectl describe/get, logs) and the text-service Service spec. Found pod healthy and bound to :9090 but Service targetPort set to 9999 — confirmed via kubectl_get of the Service and pod port bindings. Priority #2: inspected nginx-thrift pod, its mounted ConfigMap (nginx.conf and compose.lua), and nginx logs; found nginx/Lua calls target localhost:8080 while compose-post-service is available at ClusterIP:9090 (endpoints at 10.244.1.32:9090). Logs from compose-post-service show immediate Thrift connection refused to text-service:9090 consistent with the Service mapping error. Steps performed included kubectl describe/get on the three pods, fetching logs for nginx-thrift and compose-post-service, reading ConfigMap nginx-thrift, and reviewing Service and Endpoints for compose-post-service and text-service. The evidence chain links configuration errors to the observed connection-refused symptoms; no runtime crash or resource exhaustion was found on the implicated pods.
